user.title: Laundry Controller
user.description: Choose the binary sensors that report when each appliance is running and when each door is open.

data_description.name: Used as the device name and entity ID prefix, for example sensor.laundry_status.
data_description.washer_running: On while the washer is running.
data_description.dryer_running: On while the dryer is running.
data_description.washer_door: On (open) when the washer door is opened.
data_description.dryer_door: On (open) when the dryer door is opened.

features.title: Notifications and announcements
features.description: All of these are optional and can be changed later under Configure.

data_description.recipients: Notify services such as mobile_app_my_phone. Mobile-app services get action buttons and can have notifications cleared.
data_description.tts_script: Script run when the dryer finishes, for example script.smart_speaker_tts_with_light.
data_description.tts_speaker_device: Passed to the script as speaker_device.
data_description.on_air_entity: Announcements are skipped while this entity is on.

error.duplicate_entities: Each sensor must be a different entity.

abort.already_configured: These sensors are already used by another Laundry Controller.

data.notify_washer_while_dryer_running: Notify when the washer finishes while the dryer is running

data_description.recipients: Notify services such as mobile_app_my_phone. Leave empty to disable phone notifications and reminders.
data_description.notify_washer_while_dryer_running: Off by default, matching the original Node-RED flow.

announcements.title: Smart-speaker announcements
announcements.description: When the dryer finishes, the script is called with message, language, voice, volume, led_color, led_brightness, max_light_duration and (if set) speaker_device.

data.on_air_unavailable: When the On-Air entity is unavailable

data_description.on_air_entity: Announcements are skipped while this entity is on. The state is checked at announcement time.
data_description.tts_messages: One message per line. A random one is spoken each time.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: While finished laundry is waiting, a reminder is sent every interval, starting one interval after the cycle finished. Reminders outside the allowed hours are held until the window opens. Set start and end to the same time to allow reminders all day.

data_description.overdue_after: Reminders for laundry waiting longer than this are marked OVERDUE with high importance.

data_description.reconnect_grace: After a running sensor was unknown or unavailable (including at Home Assistant start-up), its reading must stay unchanged this long before a cycle is started or finished. 0 acts immediately.

config_entry_required.message: Several Laundry Controllers are set up (or none is loaded). Choose one with config_entry_id.

config_entry_not_found.message: No loaded Laundry Controller with config entry ID {entry_id}.

missing_notify_service.title: Laundry notification service missing
missing_notify_service.description: {name} tried to send a notification with {service}, but that service does not exist. Reinstall the companion app or update the recipients under Settings > Devices & services > Laundry Controller > Configure > Phone notifications.

missing_tts_script.title: Laundry announcement script missing
missing_tts_script.description: {name} tried to run {script} to announce the dryer finishing, but the script does not exist. Create it, or change the script under Configure > Smart-speaker announcements.

mark_done.name: Mark laundry done
mark_done.description: Acknowledges all finished laundry (washer and dryer). Running appliances are not touched.

config_entry_id.name: Laundry Controller
config_entry_id.description: Instance to act on. Optional when only one is set up.

hang_dry.name: Hang dry
hang_dry.description: Acknowledges a finished washer load that will be hung to dry. Does nothing if the washer is not finished.

config_entry_id.name: Laundry Controller
config_entry_id.description: Instance to act on. Optional when only one is set up.

reset.name: Reset laundry state
reset.description: Discards finished states and re-syncs each appliance with its running sensor, without counting loads or sending notifications.

config_entry_id.name: Laundry Controller
config_entry_id.description: Instance to act on. Optional when only one is set up.

set_load_count.name: Set load count
set_load_count.description: Sets the laundry load counter, for example to import the count from counter.laundry_loads.

config_entry_id.name: Laundry Controller
config_entry_id.description: Instance to act on. Optional when only one is set up.

set_last_completed.name: Set last completed
set_last_completed.description: Sets the last completed laundry timestamp, for example to import input_datetime.laundry_last_done.

config_entry_id.name: Laundry Controller
config_entry_id.description: Instance to act on. Optional when only one is set up.
